question: In which of the following years was the origin and enactment of the Indian Age of Consent Act passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1891**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Age of Consent Act was legislation enacted in British India on 19 March 1891 that raised the age of consent for sexual intercourse from ten to twelve years for all girls in all jurisdictions**__.

 
 
• The Act was also known as Act X of 1891.
 
• It was an amendment to the Indian Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, Section 375, 1882.
 
• Parishad member Sir Romesh Chunder Mitter (from Bengal) opposed it on the grounds that it interfered with the orthodox Hindu code.
 
• However, it received support from Indian reformers such as Behramji Malabari and women's social organizations.
